## Education

- **PhD in Mathematics**, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, 1981
- **BA in Mathematics and Physics, summa cum laude**, Pomona College, 1977

## Experience {.career-history}

### Illinois Institute of Technology

- **Professor of Applied Mathematics**, 2005–present
- **Vice Provost for Research**, 2018–2024
- **Director of the Center for Interdisciplinary Scientific Computation**, 2017–2018
- **Chair of Applied Mathematics**, 2005–2017

### Hong Kong Baptist University and Hong Kong Baptist College

- **Professor of Mathematics**, Hong Kong Baptist University, 1999–2005
- **Associate Professor of Mathematics**, Hong Kong Baptist University, 1995–1999
- **Head of Mathematics**, Hong Kong Baptist University, 1989–2002
- **Senior Lecturer in Mathematics**, Hong Kong Baptist College, 1987–1995
- **Lecturer in Mathematics**, Hong Kong Baptist College, 1985–1987

### University of Southern California

- **Assistant Professor of Mathematics**, 1981–1985
